meta.summary: IDR 2.0.3 runtime for measuring reproducibility between two ranked peak lists from replicate experiments.
meta.description: IDR 2.0.3 runtime for measuring reproducibility between two ranked peak lists from replicate experiments.

test: idr --version 2>&1 | grep -Fx 'IDR 2.0.3' >/dev/null && idr --help 2>&1 | grep -F 'Irreproducible Discovery Rate' >/dev/null && python -c 'import importlib.metadata as md; assert md.version("idr") == "2.0.3"; import idr, idr.inv_cdf, matplotlib, numpy, scipy; assert numpy.__version__ == "1.23.5"; assert scipy.__version__ == "1.10.1"; assert matplotlib.__version__ == "3.7.5"; print("idr-runtime-ok")' | grep -Fx 'idr-runtime-ok' >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-idr-core-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; cp /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak1_sub.narrowPeak "$tmp/peak1.narrowPeak"; cp /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak2_sub.narrowPeak "$tmp/peak2.narrowPeak"; idr --samples "$tmp/peak1.narrowPeak" "$tmp/peak2.narrowPeak" --input-file-type narrowPeak --output-file "$tmp/idr.txt" > "$tmp/run.log" 2>&1; test -s "$tmp/idr.txt"; test "$(wc -l < "$tmp/idr.txt")" -eq 71; grep -F 'Number of reported peaks - 71/71' "$tmp/run.log" >/dev/null

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-idr-plot-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; cp /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak1_sub.narrowPeak "$tmp/peak1.narrowPeak"; cp /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak2_sub.narrowPeak "$tmp/peak2.narrowPeak"; idr --samples "$tmp/peak1.narrowPeak" "$tmp/peak2.narrowPeak" --input-file-type narrowPeak --output-file "$tmp/idr.txt" --plot --quiet; test -s "$tmp/idr.txt.png"; python -c 'import struct,sys; data=open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read(24); assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"; width,height=struct.unpack(">II",data[16:24]); assert width > 100 and height > 100' "$tmp/idr.txt.png"

set -eu; tmp=/tmp/taf-idr-gzip-$$; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' 0 1 2 3; mkdir -p "$tmp"; python -c 'import gzip,shutil,sys; [shutil.copyfileobj(open(src,"rb"),gzip.open(dst,"wb")) for src,dst in ((sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]),(sys.argv[3],sys.argv[4]))]' /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak1_sub.narrowPeak "$tmp/peak1.narrowPeak.gz" /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak2_sub.narrowPeak "$tmp/peak2.narrowPeak.gz"; idr --samples "$tmp/peak1.narrowPeak.gz" "$tmp/peak2.narrowPeak.gz" --input-file-type narrowPeak --output-file "$tmp/idr.txt" --quiet; test -s "$tmp/idr.txt"; test "$(wc -l < "$tmp/idr.txt")" -eq 71

test -s /opt/idr/share/doc/idr/README.md && test -s /opt/idr/share/doc/idr/requirements.freeze.txt && test -s /opt/idr/share/doc/idr/source.txt && test -s /opt/idr/share/licenses/idr/LICENSE && test -s /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak1_sub.narrowPeak && test -s /opt/idr/share/testdata/peak2_sub.narrowPeak && echo '63e3be099b2deadfa8c7ccc3ab83659afe683f6a35bd41b2319c6ad58ca74de6  /opt/idr/share/source/idr/idr-2.0.3.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -

upstream.citation: Li Q, Brown JB, Huang H, Bickel PJ. Measuring reproducibility of high-throughput experiments. Annals of Applied Statistics 5(3), 2011.
